## How to use them
| Layer | Resources | Join key |
|---|---|---|
| food → compound (amounts) | [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[FoodAtlas]] (needs an API key), [[NPASS]] (species → compound) | food/scientific name, NCBI taxon → PubChem CID / InChIKey |
| ingredient → flavour molecules | [[FlavorDB2]] (entity ids shared with [[CulinaryDB]]) | FlavorDB entity id, PubChem CID |
| compound → disease / target | [[CTD]] (curated), [[HMDB]] (biomarker), [[NPASS]] (bioactivity), [[FooDB]] health effects (qualitative, mostly Duke) | MeSH, PubChem CID, InChIKey, UniProt |
| plant/spice → disease | [[CMAUP]] (ICD-11, trials), [[SpiceRx]] (text-mined, ±) | NCBI taxon, scientific name |
| food–drug safety | [[DDID]] (graded), [[FooDrugs]] (text + transcriptomics), [[DrugBank]] (blocked; see [[Access requests]]) | drug name / DrugBank id |
| everyday dish knowledge | [[WorldCuisines]] (dish KB; many countries, listed per country) | Wikidata id |

The full chain is described in [[Q3 Food compound & health-effect datasets]].

## Gaps
- Regional foods missing from the backbones, e.g. FooDB has no nigella/black cumin, sumac, camel milk, za'atar, ghee or labneh (see [[FooDB]]).
- Most compound → effect evidence is lab/animal or text-mined; human-evidence layers are thin ([[Exposome-Explorer]] cohorts, [[HERB]] trials).
- Licences: several are non-commercial (FooDB CC BY-NC, CTD notification, DrugBank account); see the question notes.
